constraints: Preserve browser test coverage, Karma execution mode, launch flags, and CI behavior.

steps.instructions: Choose a maintained Karma launcher supported by local and CI environments and add its package.
steps.title: Select a maintained browser launcher

steps.instructions: Replace the PhantomJS launcher and browser name in Karma configuration, then remove karma-phantomjs-launcher.
steps.title: Replace PhantomJS configuration

verification.purpose: Run the browser test suite in its supported local or CI mode.

rule.replacement: A maintained Karma browser launcher such as karma-chrome-launcher
rule.summary: npm states that PhantomJS development stopped and recommends Puppeteer or a similar maintained browser.
rule.title: karma-phantomjs-launcher is deprecated
